name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea keep forces massed on their border after clashes around Badme; interstate war not confirmed
state: Ethiopia and Eritrea massed forces along their border, heightening war fears, sources said on 18 Nov (Reuters via Korea Times). Critical Threats tracked reported fighting between Eritrean and Ethiopian forces around Badme from 9 Nov and Ethiopian drone strikes in the Irob district on 14–16 Nov, but recorded no Badme fighting after 15 Nov; many reports were unverified. Searches on 28 Nov found no confirmed direct war, so the Alert is unconfirmed and Watch holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against all or all but essential travel to parts of northern Ethiopia and the Eritrean border. Civilians in Tigray and Afar are most exposed; border fighting tends to bring displacement and cut aid routes.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration (Ethiopia–Eritrea forces massed, reported Badme clashes); new interstate war not confirmed
